next_question.rationale: Many abandonments are labelled “abandoned by system” or complain about long waits and several doctor-related cancellation reasons; that pattern looks like a problem when users request an immediate (walk-in) consultation rather than a booked appointment. I expect walk-in requests to convert from "requested a consultation" to "paid and confirmed" much worse than booked-ahead ones — if true, fixing wait/timeouts or routing for walk-ins will recover a large share of the 87,511 lost here. This matters because scheduling is an actionable routing/payment boundary (engineering and ops can change timeouts or doctor matching).
